exams.title: CTET Paper II - chosen route
items: 150 MCQs, 150 marks, standard duration 150 minutes; pen-and-paper OMR responses; one mark per correct answer and no negative marking.
CDP: 30 questions. Development 15, inclusion 5, learning/pedagogy 10. The learner age group is 11-14.
English Language I: 30 questions, split 15 comprehension + 15 pedagogy. Passages: prose/drama and poem.
Hindi Language II: 30 questions, split 15 comprehension + 15 pedagogy. Passages: two unseen prose passages.
Social Studies/Social Science: 60 questions, split 40 content + 20 pedagogy. This is the chosen alternative to Mathematics and Science.
The content base is Classes VI-VIII, with difficulty/linkages up to senior secondary. No equal fixed History/Geography/Civics split is specified.
The main paper is bilingual Hindi/English; the selected language sections are English I and Hindi II. The languages must differ.

exams.title: UGC NET - History
items: Paper I: 50 compulsory MCQs, 100 marks. Ten units; official syllabus note specifies five questions per unit.
History Paper II: 100 compulsory MCQs, 200 marks. All ten History units apply; no fixed per-unit question quota is specified.
Total: 150 questions, 300 marks, standard duration 180 minutes, CBT, no break; two marks per correct answer and no negative marking.
There is no current Paper III and no additional compulsory English, Hindi or CDP paper for NET History. The one History checklist in Part II covers its subject paper.
Exam structures follow the verified 2026 bulletins. Recheck the official portal for the session, later notices and accommodations before an attempt.
